description: Normalize messy text into clean, comparable form: Unicode NFC composition, accent folding (café → cafe), zero-width and invisible-character removal, control-character stripping and whitespace collapsing. The preprocessing step that makes string comparison and deduplication trustworthy. Use this when an agent needs to unicode NFC, accents, zero-width and control chars. x402 price $0.01/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
